messages:
amelia-cs: Heads-up — Ventana Systems is asking for an APAC peering + CIDR pin in ap-southeast-1 for a customer pilot tomorrow. They want 250 qps for a 4h window (09:00-13:00 UTC). They said this pilot affects their renewal decision. Can network/sre confirm feasibility? :wave:

jorge-net: Need exact CIDRs and whether they want dedicated egress or just pinned ACLs on edge. Dedicated peering needs ~2h prep, ACLs are faster. Also confirm start/end timestamps.

ryan-sre: From SRE: we can support a 4h burst if we stage traffic. Recommend a ramp: 125 qps first 20m, then 250 if metrics stable. Need auto-revoke at window end + rollback if p95 or error rate spikes.

tasha-support: Filed ticket CS-4999 and added the "renewal-risk" tag on the account. Will capture post-demo feedback for renewal handoff.

amelia-cs: Customer sent CIDRs:
```
{
  "cidrs": ["103.21.41.0/24", "103.21.42.0/24"],
  "start": "2026-06-11T09:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-06-11T13:00:00Z",
  "requested_qps": 250,
  "use_case": "sales pilot / exec demo"
}
```

jorge-net: ACLs applied to ap-southeast-1 edge and pinned to Ventana Systems tenant. Tested handshake from 103.21.41.12 1: SYN/ACK received. Propagation should finish in ~3m. We did not provision dedicated peering (requested ACL pin only).

billing-bot: Notice: Temporary QPS increase may affect next invoice. Estimated delta: +~$180 for 4h at requested throughput. Notify finance if actual usage exceeds estimates.

ryan-sre: Canary + monitors added: p95 latency alert > 420ms, error-rate alert > 1%, token-usage anomaly (>1.8x baseline). Rollback: cutoff to default hosted pool after 3 consecutive 5m breaches. Autoscale policy set to allow short-term burst capacity.

ticket-bot: Ticket CS-4999 updated: region=ap-southeast-1, cidrs added, temp_qps=250, ramp_policy=staged, auto_revoke=2026-06-11T13:00:00Z. Assigned to jorge-net, ryan-sre.

tasha-support: Logged the ask in renewal tracker and added a feedback form to send to Ventana post-demo. Sales notified for possible expedited renewal.

amelia-cs: Perfect 10x. I'll confirm demo time with the customer and post results here. Please keep alerts loud during the window.
